# 00. SETUP
```{r setup}
################################################################################
# 00. SETUP
################################################################################

# Data management
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(openxlsx)

# Statistics
library(fixest)

# Options
options(scipen = 999, width = 140)
```

# 01. DATA CLEANING

## 01.1 State lookup
```{r clean-states}
################################################################################
# 01.1 State lookup (50 states + DC)
################################################################################

# FIPS codes and names come from the Census file header rows (read below);
# here only the name/abbreviation key used to join ARCOS (upper-case names)
states <- tibble(
  state_name = c(state.name, "District of Columbia"),
  state_abb  = c(state.abb, "DC")
) %>%
  mutate(state_upper = toupper(state_name))

print(nrow(states))
```

## 01.2 Census population by age group
```{r clean-census}
################################################################################
# 01.2 Census population, state x year x age group
################################################################################

# Vintage 2020 (2017-2019) and Vintage 2025 (2020-2025) state single-year-of-age files
pop_v2020 <- read_csv("raw/census/SC-EST2020-ALLDATA6.csv", col_types = cols(.default = "c")) %>%
  filter(SUMLEV == "040", SEX == "0", ORIGIN == "0") %>%
  select(state_fips = STATE, state_name = NAME, age = AGE,
         POPESTIMATE2017, POPESTIMATE2018, POPESTIMATE2019) %>%
  pivot_longer(starts_with("POPESTIMATE"), names_to = "year", values_to = "pop")

pop_v2025 <- read_csv("raw/census/sc-est2025-alldata6.csv", col_types = cols(.default = "c")) %>%
  filter(SUMLEV == "040", SEX == "0", ORIGIN == "0") %>%
  select(state_fips = STATE, state_name = NAME, age = AGE,
         POPESTIMATE2020, POPESTIMATE2021, POPESTIMATE2022,
         POPESTIMATE2023, POPESTIMATE2024, POPESTIMATE2025) %>%
  pivot_longer(starts_with("POPESTIMATE"), names_to = "year", values_to = "pop")

# Sum over race groups, then over age bands
pop_state_year <- bind_rows(pop_v2020, pop_v2025) %>%
  mutate(
    year = as.integer(str_remove(year, "POPESTIMATE")),
    age = as.integer(age),
    pop = as.numeric(pop),
    age_group = case_when(
      age >= 18 & age <= 44 ~ "pop_18_44",
      age >= 45 & age <= 54 ~ "pop_45_54",
      age >= 55 & age <= 74 ~ "pop_55_74",
      age >= 75             ~ "pop_75plus",
      TRUE                  ~ "pop_0_17"
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(state_fips, state_name, year, age_group) %>%
  summarise(pop = sum(pop), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = age_group, values_from = pop) %>%
  mutate(pop_total = pop_0_17 + pop_18_44 + pop_45_54 + pop_55_74 + pop_75plus,
         state_fips = as.integer(state_fips)) %>%
  inner_join(states, by = "state_name")

print(nrow(pop_state_year))
print(pop_state_year %>% group_by(year) %>% summarise(pop_18_44 = sum(pop_18_44), pop_55_74 = sum(pop_55_74)))
```

## 01.3 ARCOS retail distribution (Report 02, grams by state and quarter)
```{r clean-arcos}
################################################################################
# 01.3 ARCOS Report 02, parsed from the DEA yearly PDFs (pdftotext -layout)
################################################################################

# All text lines of all yearly reports, tagged with file
arcos_lines <- tibble(file = list.files("raw/arcos/txt", pattern = "\\.txt$", full.names = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(text = map(file, read_lines)) %>%
  unnest(text) %>%
  mutate(year = as.integer(str_extract(basename(file), "\\d{4}")))

# Section marker (Report 02 only) and drug code, filled down
arcos_parsed <- arcos_lines %>%
  mutate(
    section = case_when(
      str_detect(text, "ARCOS 3 - REPORT 0?2( |$)") ~ "r02",
      str_detect(text, "ARCOS 3 - REPORT 0?[13-9]( |$)") ~ "other",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    drug_code = str_match(text, "DRUG(?: CODE)?: ?(\\d{4})")[, 2]
  ) %>%
  group_by(file) %>%
  fill(section, drug_code) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(section == "r02") %>%
  mutate(m = str_match(text, "^\\s*([A-Z][A-Z .']+?)\\s{2,}([\\d,.]+)\\s+([\\d,.]+)\\s+([\\d,.]+)\\s+([\\d,.]+)\\s+([\\d,.]+)\\s*$")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(m[, 1])) %>%
  transmute(
    year, drug_code,
    state_upper = str_trim(m[, 2]),
    q1 = parse_number(m[, 3]), q2 = parse_number(m[, 4]),
    q3 = parse_number(m[, 5]), q4 = parse_number(m[, 6]),
    total = parse_number(m[, 7])
  )

# Keep the four stimulant classes and the 50 states + DC
arcos_state_quarter <- arcos_parsed %>%
  filter(drug_code %in% c("1100", "1205", "1724")) %>%
  inner_join(states, by = "state_upper") %>%
  distinct(year, drug_code, state_abb, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  pivot_longer(q1:q4, names_to = "quarter", values_to = "grams") %>%
  mutate(
    quarter = as.integer(str_remove(quarter, "q")),
    drug = recode(drug_code, "1100" = "amphetamine", "1205" = "lisdexamfetamine", "1724" = "methylphenidate")
  ) %>%
  select(state_abb, year, quarter, drug, grams) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = drug, values_from = grams, names_prefix = "g_")

# Check: one row per state x quarter, 51 states x 36 quarters
print(nrow(arcos_state_quarter))
print(arcos_state_quarter %>% count(year))
print(arcos_parsed %>% filter(drug_code %in% c("1100", "1205", "1724")) %>%
        inner_join(states, by = "state_upper") %>%
        mutate(check = abs(q1 + q2 + q3 + q4 - total)) %>%
        summarise(max_sum_error_grams = max(check)))
```

## 01.4 Label reference daily doses (DailyMed) and supply per 1,000 residents 18-44
```{r clean-supply}
################################################################################
# 01.4 Supply in label-based daily doses per 1,000 residents aged 18-44 per day
################################################################################

# Reference daily doses from FDA labels (raw/other/dailymed), see decisions_log.md
#   amphetamine: Adderall XR adult recommended 20 mg/day = 12.5 mg amphetamine base
#   lisdexamfetamine: Vyvanse adult starting dose 30 mg/day
#   methylphenidate: Ritalin adult average 20-30 mg/day, midpoint 25 mg
rdd_mg <- c(amphetamine = 12.5, lisdexamfetamine = 30, methylphenidate = 25)
print(rdd_mg)

supply_state_quarter <- arcos_state_quarter %>%
  left_join(pop_state_year %>% select(state_abb, state_fips, year, pop_18_44), by = c("state_abb", "year")) %>%
  mutate(
    days = case_when(quarter == 1 ~ 90, quarter == 2 ~ 91, TRUE ~ 92) + if_else(quarter == 1 & year %% 4 == 0, 1, 0),
    d_amph   = g_amphetamine * 1000 / rdd_mg["amphetamine"],
    d_lisdex = g_lisdexamfetamine * 1000 / rdd_mg["lisdexamfetamine"],
    d_mph    = g_methylphenidate * 1000 / rdd_mg["methylphenidate"],
    d_amph_class = d_amph + d_lisdex,
    rdd_amph_class_per1000 = d_amph_class / days / pop_18_44 * 1000,
    rdd_amph_per1000       = d_amph / days / pop_18_44 * 1000,
    rdd_mph_per1000        = d_mph / days / pop_18_44 * 1000,
    t = (year - 2017) * 4 + quarter,
    yq = year + (quarter - 1) / 4
  )

print(summary(supply_state_quarter$rdd_amph_class_per1000))
```

## 01.5 Shortage intensity per state (observed vs own pre-trend)
```{r clean-intensity}
################################################################################
# 01.5 Shortage intensity: observed vs expected from each state's 2017Q1-2022Q3 trend
################################################################################

# One linear trend + quarter-of-year seasonality per state, fitted on 2017Q1-2022Q3 (t <= 23)
supply_pre <- supply_state_quarter %>% filter(t <= 23)

pre_trend_amph_class <- feols(
  log(rdd_amph_class_per1000) ~ i(state_abb, t) + i(state_abb, i.quarter, ref2 = 1) | state_abb,
  data = supply_pre
)
pre_trend_amph <- feols(
  log(rdd_amph_per1000) ~ i(state_abb, t) + i(state_abb, i.quarter, ref2 = 1) | state_abb,
  data = supply_pre
)
pre_trend_mph <- feols(
  log(rdd_mph_per1000) ~ i(state_abb, t) + i(state_abb, i.quarter, ref2 = 1) | state_abb,
  data = supply_pre
)
print(r2(pre_trend_amph_class, "r2"))

# Expected values for every quarter, and the quarterly gap
supply_state_quarter <- supply_state_quarter %>%
  mutate(
    exp_amph_class = exp(predict(pre_trend_amph_class, newdata = supply_state_quarter)),
    exp_amph = exp(predict(pre_trend_amph, newdata = supply_state_quarter)),
    exp_mph = exp(predict(pre_trend_mph, newdata = supply_state_quarter)),
    gap_amph_class = 1 - rdd_amph_class_per1000 / exp_amph_class,
    gap_amph = 1 - rdd_amph_per1000 / exp_amph
  )

# Intensity = shortfall over the outcome window (2022Q4-2024Q4) and the full window (2022Q4-2025Q4)
intensity_state <- supply_state_quarter %>%
  group_by(state_abb, state_fips) %>%
  summarise(
    intensity = 1 - sum(rdd_amph_class_per1000[t >= 24 & t <= 32]) / sum(exp_amph_class[t >= 24 & t <= 32]),
    intensity_to2025 = 1 - sum(rdd_amph_class_per1000[t >= 24]) / sum(exp_amph_class[t >= 24]),
    intensity_amph_only = 1 - sum(rdd_amph_per1000[t >= 24 & t <= 32]) / sum(exp_amph[t >= 24 & t <= 32]),
    intensity_net = (sum(exp_amph_class[t >= 24 & t <= 32]) - sum(rdd_amph_class_per1000[t >= 24 & t <= 32]) -
                     (sum(rdd_mph_per1000[t >= 24 & t <= 32]) - sum(exp_mph[t >= 24 & t <= 32]))) /
                    sum(exp_amph_class[t >= 24 & t <= 32]),
    intensity_acute = 1 - sum(rdd_amph_class_per1000[t >= 24 & t <= 28]) / sum(exp_amph_class[t >= 24 & t <= 28]),
    baseline_rdd_per1000 = mean(rdd_amph_class_per1000[t >= 20 & t <= 23]),
    baseline_mph_per1000 = mean(rdd_mph_per1000[t >= 20 & t <= 23]),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(intensity_state %>% arrange(desc(intensity)), n = 51)
```

## 01.6 FARS crash files 2017-2024
```{r clean-fars-read}
################################################################################
# 01.6 FARS: accident, person, vehicle, driver factors, drugs
################################################################################

fars_dir <- "raw/fars/x"

# Accident level
fars_accident <- tibble(file = list.files(fars_dir, pattern = "^accident\\.csv$", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(d = map(file, ~ read_csv(.x, col_select = c(STATE, ST_CASE, YEAR, MONTH, HOUR, VE_FORMS, PEDS, FATALS), col_types = cols(.default = "i"), locale = locale(encoding = "latin1")))) %>%
  unnest(d) %>%
  select(-file)

# Person level (drivers, pedestrians)
fars_person <- tibble(file = list.files(fars_dir, pattern = "^person\\.csv$", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(d = map(file, ~ read_csv(.x, col_select = c(STATE, ST_CASE, VEH_NO, PER_NO, PER_TYP, AGE, INJ_SEV, ALC_RES), col_types = cols(.default = "i"), locale = locale(encoding = "latin1")))) %>%
  unnest(d) %>%
  mutate(year = as.integer(str_extract(file, "(?<=/)\\d{4}(?=/)"))) %>%
  select(-file)

# Vehicle level (speeding, 2017-2019 driver factors)
fars_vehicle <- tibble(file = list.files(fars_dir, pattern = "^vehicle\\.csv$", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(d = map(file, ~ read_csv(.x, col_select = c(ST_CASE, VEH_NO, SPEEDREL, any_of(c("DR_SF1NAME", "DR_SF2NAME", "DR_SF3NAME", "DR_SF4NAME"))), col_types = cols(.default = "c"), locale = locale(encoding = "latin1")))) %>%
  unnest(d) %>%
  mutate(year = as.integer(str_extract(file, "(?<=/)\\d{4}(?=/)"))) %>%
  select(-file)

# Driver-related factors 2020-2024 (one row per factor)
fars_driverrf <- tibble(file = list.files(fars_dir, pattern = "^driverrf\\.csv$", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(d = map(file, ~ read_csv(.x, col_select = c(ST_CASE, VEH_NO, DRIVERRFNAME), col_types = cols(.default = "c"), locale = locale(encoding = "latin1")))) %>%
  unnest(d) %>%
  mutate(year = as.integer(str_extract(file, "(?<=/)\\d{4}(?=/)"))) %>%
  select(-file)

# Drug test results 2018-2024 (one row per result)
fars_drugs <- tibble(file = list.files(fars_dir, pattern = "^drugs\\.csv$", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(d = map(file, ~ read_csv(.x, col_select = c(ST_CASE, VEH_NO, PER_NO, DRUGRESNAME), col_types = cols(.default = "c"), locale = locale(encoding = "latin1")))) %>%
  unnest(d) %>%
  mutate(year = as.integer(str_extract(file, "(?<=/)\\d{4}(?=/)"))) %>%
  select(-file)

print(fars_accident %>% count(YEAR))
print(fars_accident %>% group_by(YEAR) %>% summarise(deaths = sum(FATALS)))
```

```{r clean-fars-drivers}
################################################################################
# 01.6b FARS driver-level flags
################################################################################

# Driver error: any reported driver-related factor that is a driving behaviour
driver_error_pattern <- "Careless|Inattent|Yield|Lane|Erratic|Reckless|Obey|Overcorrect|Wrong Side|Following|Aggressive|Racing|Speed|Improper|Passing|Turning|Fail"

driver_error_2017_2019 <- fars_vehicle %>%
  filter(year <= 2019) %>%
  pivot_longer(starts_with("DR_SF"), values_to = "factor_name") %>%
  group_by(year, ST_CASE, VEH_NO) %>%
  summarise(driver_error = any(str_detect(factor_name, driver_error_pattern), na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

driver_error_2020_2024 <- fars_driverrf %>%
  group_by(year, ST_CASE, VEH_NO) %>%
  summarise(driver_error = any(str_detect(DRIVERRFNAME, driver_error_pattern), na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Drug results per person: tested, amphetamine-positive, methamphetamine-positive
drug_person <- fars_drugs %>%
  mutate(res = str_to_lower(str_trim(DRUGRESNAME))) %>%
  group_by(year, ST_CASE, VEH_NO, PER_NO) %>%
  summarise(
    tested = any(!str_detect(res, "not given|unknown|not reported|^test refused") & res != ""),
    amph_pos = any(res %in% c("amphetamine", "amphetamine sulfate", "dextroamphetamine", "lisdexamfetamine")),
    meth_pos = any(res == "methamphetamine"),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(c(ST_CASE, VEH_NO, PER_NO), as.integer))

# Drivers with flags
drivers <- fars_person %>%
  filter(PER_TYP == 1) %>%
  left_join(fars_vehicle %>% transmute(year, ST_CASE = as.integer(ST_CASE), VEH_NO = as.integer(VEH_NO),
                                       speeding = as.integer(SPEEDREL) %in% c(2, 3, 4, 5)),
            by = c("year", "ST_CASE", "VEH_NO")) %>%
  left_join(bind_rows(driver_error_2017_2019, driver_error_2020_2024) %>%
              mutate(across(c(ST_CASE, VEH_NO), as.integer)),
            by = c("year", "ST_CASE", "VEH_NO")) %>%
  left_join(drug_person, by = c("year", "ST_CASE", "VEH_NO", "PER_NO")) %>%
  mutate(
    driver_error = coalesce(driver_error, FALSE),
    tested = coalesce(tested, FALSE),
    amph_only_pos = coalesce(amph_pos & !meth_pos, FALSE),
    meth_pos = coalesce(meth_pos, FALSE),
    bac_08 = ALC_RES >= 80 & ALC_RES < 995,
    age_band = case_when(
      AGE >= 18 & AGE <= 44 ~ "young",
      AGE >= 45 & AGE <= 54 ~ "middle",
      AGE >= 55 & AGE <= 74 ~ "older",
      AGE >= 75 & AGE < 998 ~ "oldest",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

print(nrow(drivers))
print(drivers %>% count(year, age_band) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = age_band, values_from = n))
print(drivers %>% filter(year >= 2018) %>% group_by(year) %>% summarise(tested = mean(tested), amph_only = sum(amph_only_pos), meth = sum(meth_pos)))
```

```{r clean-fars-crashes}
################################################################################
# 01.6c FARS crash-level flags and state x quarter counts
################################################################################

# Crash-level: which driver age bands are involved, and driver traits
crash_flags <- drivers %>%
  group_by(year, ST_CASE) %>%
  summarise(
    any_young = any(age_band == "young", na.rm = TRUE),
    any_older = any(age_band == "older", na.rm = TRUE),
    any_oldest = any(age_band == "oldest", na.rm = TRUE),
    young_error = any(age_band == "young" & driver_error, na.rm = TRUE),
    young_speed = any(age_band == "young" & speeding, na.rm = TRUE),
    young_bac = any(age_band == "young" & bac_08, na.rm = TRUE),
    older_error = any(age_band == "older" & driver_error, na.rm = TRUE),
    older_speed = any(age_band == "older" & speeding, na.rm = TRUE),
    young_tested = any(age_band == "young" & tested, na.rm = TRUE),
    young_amph = any(age_band == "young" & amph_only_pos, na.rm = TRUE),
    young_meth = any(age_band == "young" & meth_pos, na.rm = TRUE),
    older_tested = any(age_band == "older" & tested, na.rm = TRUE),
    older_amph = any(age_band == "older" & amph_only_pos, na.rm = TRUE),
    older_meth = any(age_band == "older" & meth_pos, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Pedestrians killed per crash
ped_deaths <- fars_person %>%
  filter(PER_TYP == 5, INJ_SEV == 4) %>%
  count(year, ST_CASE, name = "ped_killed")

crashes <- fars_accident %>%
  rename(year = YEAR) %>%
  left_join(crash_flags, by = c("year", "ST_CASE")) %>%
  left_join(ped_deaths, by = c("year", "ST_CASE")) %>%
  mutate(
    across(any_young:older_meth, ~ coalesce(.x, FALSE)),
    ped_killed = coalesce(ped_killed, 0L),
    quarter = (MONTH - 1) %/% 3 + 1,
    single = VE_FORMS == 1,
    daytime = HOUR >= 6 & HOUR <= 17
  )

# State x quarter counts
fars_state_quarter <- crashes %>%
  group_by(state_fips = STATE, year, quarter) %>%
  summarise(
    crash_young = sum(any_young),
    deaths_young = sum(FATALS[any_young]),
    crash_older = sum(any_older),
    deaths_older = sum(FATALS[any_older]),
    crash_oldest = sum(any_oldest),
    crash_young_single = sum(any_young & single),
    crash_young_multi = sum(any_young & !single),
    crash_young_day = sum(any_young & daytime),
    crash_young_night = sum(any_young & !daytime),
    crash_young_error = sum(young_error),
    crash_young_speed = sum(young_speed),
    crash_young_bac = sum(young_bac),
    crash_older_single = sum(any_older & single),
    crash_older_day = sum(any_older & daytime),
    crash_older_error = sum(older_error),
    crash_older_speed = sum(older_speed),
    crash_young_tested = sum(young_tested),
    crash_young_amph = sum(young_amph),
    crash_young_meth = sum(young_meth),
    crash_older_tested = sum(older_tested),
    crash_older_amph = sum(older_amph),
    crash_older_meth = sum(older_meth),
    ped_deaths_older_only = sum(ped_killed[any_older & !any_young]),
    crash_all = n(),
    deaths_all = sum(FATALS),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(nrow(fars_state_quarter))
print(fars_state_quarter %>% group_by(year) %>% summarise(across(c(crash_young, crash_older, crash_oldest, deaths_young), sum)))
```

## 01.7 FHWA vehicle miles traveled (Traffic Volume Trends, Table 5)
```{r clean-vmt}
################################################################################
# 01.7 FHWA monthly state VMT (millions), current-month preliminary estimate
################################################################################

vmt_files <- list.files("raw/other/tvt", pattern = "tvt\\.xlsx?$", full.names = TRUE)

vmt_state_month <- tibble(file = vmt_files) %>%
  mutate(sheet = map(file, ~ read_excel(.x, sheet = "Page 6", col_names = FALSE, col_types = "text", .name_repair = "minimal") %>%
                       select(state_name = 1, cmiles = 5))) %>%
  unnest(sheet) %>%
  mutate(
    yy = as.integer(str_sub(basename(file), 1, 2)),
    mon = str_sub(basename(file), 3, 5),
    year = 2000L + yy,
    month = match(mon, str_to_lower(month.abb)),
    state_name = str_trim(state_name),
    vmt_millions = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(cmiles))
  ) %>%
  inner_join(states %>% select(state_name, state_abb), by = "state_name") %>%
  filter(!is.na(vmt_millions))

vmt_state_quarter <- vmt_state_month %>%
  mutate(quarter = (month - 1) %/% 3 + 1) %>%
  group_by(state_abb, year, quarter) %>%
  summarise(vmt_millions = sum(vmt_millions), n_months = n(), .groups = "drop")

print(vmt_state_quarter %>% count(year, n_months))
```

## 01.8 Analysis panel: state x quarter, 2017Q1-2024Q4
```{r clean-panel}
################################################################################
# 01.8 Merge into the state x quarter panel
################################################################################

panel <- fars_state_quarter %>%
  filter(year <= 2024) %>%
  inner_join(pop_state_year %>% select(state_fips, state_abb, state_name, year, pop_18_44, pop_55_74, pop_75plus, pop_total),
             by = c("state_fips", "year")) %>%
  left_join(vmt_state_quarter %>% select(state_abb, year, quarter, vmt_millions), by = c("state_abb", "year", "quarter")) %>%
  left_join(intensity_state %>% select(-state_fips), by = "state_abb") %>%
  left_join(supply_state_quarter %>% select(state_abb, year, quarter, rdd_amph_class_per1000, exp_amph_class, gap_amph_class),
            by = c("state_abb", "year", "quarter")) %>%
  mutate(
    t = (year - 2017) * 4 + quarter,
    yq = sprintf("%dQ%d", year, quarter),
    rel_q = t - 24,
    post = as.integer(t >= 24),
    covid = as.integer(year %in% c(2020, 2021)),
    late = as.integer(t >= 29),
    post_quota = as.integer(t >= 32)
  ) %>%
  arrange(state_abb, t)

print(nrow(panel))
print(n_distinct(panel$state_abb))
print(sum(is.na(panel$vmt_millions)))
```

## 01.9 CDC provisional overdose deaths (secondary outcome)
```{r clean-cdc}
################################################################################
# 01.9 CDC VSRR provisional drug overdose deaths, 12-month ending December
################################################################################

cdc_overdose <- read_csv("raw/other/cdc_vsrr_overdose.csv", col_types = cols(.default = "c")) %>%
  filter(Month == "December",
         Indicator %in% c("Psychostimulants with abuse potential (T43.6)", "Number of Drug Overdose Deaths",
                          "Number of Deaths")) %>%
  transmute(
    state_name = `State Name`,
    year = as.integer(Year),
    indicator = recode(Indicator,
                       "Psychostimulants with abuse potential (T43.6)" = "od_psychostim",
                       "Number of Drug Overdose Deaths" = "od_all",
                       "Number of Deaths" = "deaths_all_causes"),
    value = parse_number(`Data Value`)
  ) %>%
  inner_join(states %>% select(state_name, state_abb), by = "state_name") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = indicator, values_from = value) %>%
  left_join(pop_state_year %>% select(state_abb, year, pop_total, pop_18_44), by = c("state_abb", "year")) %>%
  left_join(intensity_state %>% select(state_abb, intensity), by = "state_abb") %>%
  filter(year >= 2017)

print(cdc_overdose %>% group_by(year) %>% summarise(n = n(), psychostim = sum(od_psychostim, na.rm = TRUE), missing = sum(is.na(od_psychostim))))
```

## 01.10 Write clean data
```{r clean-write}
################################################################################
# 01.10 Write analysis datasets, one sheet each
################################################################################

national_quarter <- panel %>%
  group_by(year, quarter, t, yq) %>%
  summarise(across(c(starts_with("crash_"), starts_with("deaths_"), pop_18_44, pop_55_74, pop_75plus, vmt_millions), sum),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(supply_state_quarter %>% group_by(year, quarter) %>%
              summarise(rdd_amph_class = sum(d_amph_class / days) / sum(pop_18_44) * 1000,
                        rdd_amph = sum(d_amph / days) / sum(pop_18_44) * 1000,
                        rdd_mph = sum(d_mph / days) / sum(pop_18_44) * 1000,
                        exp_amph_class = sum(exp_amph_class * pop_18_44) / sum(pop_18_44),
                        .groups = "drop"),
            by = c("year", "quarter"))

supply_national <- supply_state_quarter %>%
  group_by(year, quarter, t) %>%
  summarise(rdd_amph_class = sum(d_amph_class / days) / sum(pop_18_44) * 1000,
            rdd_amph = sum(d_amph / days) / sum(pop_18_44) * 1000,
            rdd_lisdex = sum(d_lisdex / days) / sum(pop_18_44) * 1000,
            rdd_mph = sum(d_mph / days) / sum(pop_18_44) * 1000,
            exp_amph_class = sum(exp_amph_class * pop_18_44) / sum(pop_18_44),
            exp_mph = sum(exp_mph * pop_18_44) / sum(pop_18_44),
            .groups = "drop")

clean_wb <- createWorkbook()
addWorksheet(clean_wb, "panel_state_quarter");   writeData(clean_wb, "panel_state_quarter", panel)
addWorksheet(clean_wb, "supply_state_quarter");  writeData(clean_wb, "supply_state_quarter", supply_state_quarter)
addWorksheet(clean_wb, "supply_national");       writeData(clean_wb, "supply_national", supply_national)
addWorksheet(clean_wb, "intensity_state");       writeData(clean_wb, "intensity_state", intensity_state)
addWorksheet(clean_wb, "national_quarter");      writeData(clean_wb, "national_quarter", national_quarter)
addWorksheet(clean_wb, "cdc_overdose_state_year"); writeData(clean_wb, "cdc_overdose_state_year", cdc_overdose)
addWorksheet(clean_wb, "population_state_year"); writeData(clean_wb, "population_state_year", pop_state_year)
saveWorkbook(clean_wb, "clean_data.xlsx", overwrite = TRUE)

print(getSheetNames("clean_data.xlsx"))
```

# F. FEASIBILITY: SHORTAGE INTENSITY

## F.1 Data preparation
```{r f1}
################################################################################
# F.1 Data preparation
################################################################################

f_supply_national <- read_excel("clean_data.xlsx", sheet = "supply_national")
f_intensity <- read_excel("clean_data.xlsx", sheet = "intensity_state")
f_supply_state <- read_excel("clean_data.xlsx", sheet = "supply_state_quarter")

print(nrow(f_intensity))
```

## F.2 Analysis
```{r f2}
################################################################################
# F.2 Analysis
################################################################################

# National observed vs expected amphetamine-class supply, by period
f_national_gap <- f_supply_national %>%
  mutate(period = case_when(
    t <= 23 ~ "1 pre (2017Q1-2022Q3)",
    t <= 28 ~ "2 acute (2022Q4-2023Q4)",
    t <= 32 ~ "3 2024",
    TRUE ~ "4 2025"
  )) %>%
  group_by(period) %>%
  summarise(observed = mean(rdd_amph_class), expected = mean(exp_amph_class),
            gap_pct = 100 * (1 - sum(rdd_amph_class) / sum(exp_amph_class)),
            mph_observed = mean(rdd_mph), mph_expected = mean(exp_mph))
print(f_national_gap)

# National gap by quarter
print(f_supply_national %>% filter(t >= 20) %>%
        transmute(year, quarter, rdd_amph_class, exp_amph_class, gap_pct = 100 * (1 - rdd_amph_class / exp_amph_class),
                  rdd_amph, rdd_lisdex, rdd_mph), n = 20)

# Pooled shortfall 2022Q4-2024Q4 (population weighted)
f_gap_window <- f_supply_state %>%
  filter(t >= 24, t <= 32) %>%
  summarise(gap = 1 - sum(rdd_amph_class_per1000 * pop_18_44) / sum(exp_amph_class * pop_18_44))
print(f_gap_window)

# Spread of state intensity
print(summary(f_intensity$intensity))
print(c(sd = sd(f_intensity$intensity),
        mean = mean(f_intensity$intensity),
        cv = sd(f_intensity$intensity) / abs(mean(f_intensity$intensity)),
        range = diff(range(f_intensity$intensity))))
print(cor(f_intensity %>% select(intensity, intensity_to2025, intensity_amph_only, intensity_net, intensity_acute)))
print(f_intensity %>% arrange(desc(intensity)) %>% select(state_abb, intensity, intensity_acute, intensity_net), n = 51)
```

# E. EXPECTED EFFECT AND POWER (computed before outcome models)

## E.1 Data preparation
```{r e1}
################################################################################
# E.1 Data preparation
################################################################################

e_supply_state <- read_excel("clean_data.xlsx", sheet = "supply_state_quarter")
e_intensity <- read_excel("clean_data.xlsx", sheet = "intensity_state")
e_panel <- read_excel("clean_data.xlsx", sheet = "panel_state_quarter")

# Pre-2020 data only (no post-shortage outcomes used for power)
e_pre <- e_panel %>% filter(year <= 2019)
print(nrow(e_pre))
```

## E.2 Analysis
```{r e2}
################################################################################
# E.2 Analysis
################################################################################

# Share of residents 18-44 on amphetamine-class stimulant on a given day (upper bound: all doses assigned to 18-44)
e_share <- e_supply_state %>%
  filter(t >= 20, t <= 23) %>%
  summarise(share = sum(d_amph_class / days) / sum(pop_18_44)) %>%
  pull(share)
print(e_share)

# Supply drop, population weighted: full window and acute window
e_drop_window <- e_supply_state %>% filter(t >= 24, t <= 32) %>%
  summarise(gap = 1 - sum(rdd_amph_class_per1000 * pop_18_44) / sum(exp_amph_class * pop_18_44)) %>% pull(gap)
e_drop_acute <- e_supply_state %>% filter(t >= 24, t <= 28) %>%
  summarise(gap = 1 - sum(rdd_amph_class_per1000 * pop_18_44) / sum(exp_amph_class * pop_18_44)) %>% pull(gap)
print(c(drop_window = e_drop_window, drop_acute = e_drop_acute))

# Expected % increase in young-driver fatal crashes = share x drop x (0.38 to 0.58)
e_expected <- tibble(
  window = c("2022Q4-2024Q4", "2022Q4-2024Q4", "2022Q4-2023Q4", "2022Q4-2023Q4"),
  chang = c(0.38, 0.58, 0.38, 0.58),
  drop = c(e_drop_window, e_drop_window, e_drop_acute, e_drop_acute)
) %>%
  mutate(
    expected_pct_prompt = 100 * e_share * drop * chang,
    expected_pct_rr = 100 * e_share * drop * (1 / (1 - chang) - 1)
  )
print(e_expected)

# Baseline counts (2017-2019) for expected excess crashes per quarter
e_baseline <- e_pre %>% group_by(year, quarter) %>% summarise(crash_young = sum(crash_young), deaths_young = sum(deaths_young), .groups = "drop") %>%
  summarise(crash_young_q = mean(crash_young), deaths_young_q = mean(deaths_young))
print(e_baseline)

# Power: SE of the dose-response DiD in pre-period data with a placebo post at 2018Q3 (pre-2020 only)
e_power_dose <- fepois(
  crash_young ~ intensity:I(t >= 7) + log(vmt_millions) | state_abb + t,
  offset = ~ log(pop_18_44),
  cluster = ~ state_abb,
  data = e_pre
)
print(summary(e_power_dose))
e_se_dose <- se(e_power_dose)["intensity:I(t >= 7)"]

# Power: SE of the age DiD (young vs 55-74) in pre-period data with placebo post at 2018Q3
e_pre_long <- bind_rows(
  e_pre %>% transmute(state_abb, t, young = 1, crashes = crash_young, pop = pop_18_44),
  e_pre %>% transmute(state_abb, t, young = 0, crashes = crash_older, pop = pop_55_74)
)
e_power_age <- fepois(
  crashes ~ young:I(t >= 7) | state_abb^young + t,
  offset = ~ log(pop),
  cluster = ~ state_abb,
  data = e_pre_long
)
print(summary(e_power_age))
e_se_age <- se(e_power_age)["young:I(t >= 7)"]

# Minimum detectable effects (80% power, two-sided alpha 0.05: 2.80 x SE)
e_mde <- tibble(
  design = c("dose-response, per 1.0 shortfall", "dose-response, 87.5th vs 12.5th percentile state", "age DiD (national shock)"),
  mde_log = c(2.80 * e_se_dose,
              2.80 * e_se_dose * (quantile(e_intensity$intensity, 0.875) - quantile(e_intensity$intensity, 0.125)),
              2.80 * e_se_age)
) %>%
  mutate(mde_pct = 100 * (exp(mde_log) - 1))
print(e_mde)
print(quantile(e_intensity$intensity, c(0.125, 0.875)))
```

## E.3 Updated power with state x quarter-of-year FE (added after first results; see decisions_log.md)
```{r e3}
################################################################################
# E.3 Updated MDE, same pre-2020 placebo design, seasonal FE added
################################################################################

e_power_dose_season <- fepois(
  crash_young ~ intensity:I(t >= 7) + log(vmt_millions) | state_abb^quarter + t,
  offset = ~ log(pop_18_44),
  cluster = ~ state_abb,
  data = e_pre
)
print(summary(e_power_dose_season))
print(c(mde_pct_per_10pp = 100 * (exp(2.80 * se(e_power_dose_season)["intensity:I(t >= 7)"] / 10) - 1),
        mde_pct_p875_vs_p125 = 100 * (exp(2.80 * se(e_power_dose_season)["intensity:I(t >= 7)"] *
                                       (quantile(e_intensity$intensity, 0.875) - quantile(e_intensity$intensity, 0.125))) - 1)))
```

# A2. NATIONAL COMPARISON: DRIVERS 18-44 VS 55-74

## A2.1 Data preparation
```{r a2-1}
################################################################################
# A2.1 Data preparation
################################################################################

a2_panel <- read_excel("clean_data.xlsx", sheet = "panel_state_quarter")

# Long format: one row per state x quarter x age group
a2_long <- bind_rows(
  a2_panel %>% transmute(state_abb, year, quarter, t, yq, post, covid, young = 1, crashes = crash_young, deaths = deaths_young, pop = pop_18_44),
  a2_panel %>% transmute(state_abb, year, quarter, t, yq, post, covid, young = 0, crashes = crash_older, deaths = deaths_older, pop = pop_55_74)
)

# Main sample excludes 2020-2021
a2_main <- a2_long %>% filter(covid == 0)

print(nrow(a2_long))
print(nrow(a2_main))
print(a2_main %>% count(young))
```

## A2.2 Analysis
```{r a2-2}
################################################################################
# A2.2 Analysis
################################################################################

# DiD: young x post, state-quarter FE absorb all shocks common to both age groups (VMT, economy, policy)
a2_model_did <- fepois(
  crashes ~ young:post | state_abb^t + state_abb^young^quarter,
  offset = ~ log(pop),
  cluster = ~ state_abb,
  data = a2_main
)
print(summary(a2_model_did))
print(coeftable(a2_model_did)["young:post", ])
print(exp(confint(a2_model_did)["young:post", ]))
print(exp(coef(a2_model_did)["young:post"]))

# Event study: young x quarter, reference = one quarter of each season before the shortage (2019Q4, 2022Q1-Q3), because seasonal FE absorb one level per season
a2_model_es <- fepois(
  crashes ~ i(t, young, ref = c(12, 21, 22, 23)) | state_abb^t + state_abb^young^quarter,
  offset = ~ log(pop),
  cluster = ~ state_abb,
  data = a2_main
)
print(summary(a2_model_es))
print(wald(a2_model_es, keep = "t::([1-9]|1[01]):young$"))

# Deaths instead of crashes
a2_model_deaths <- fepois(
  deaths ~ young:post | state_abb^t + state_abb^young^quarter,
  offset = ~ log(pop),
  cluster = ~ state_abb,
  data = a2_main
)
print(summary(a2_model_deaths))
print(exp(confint(a2_model_deaths)["young:post", ]))
```

## A2.3 Robustness
```{r a2-3}
################################################################################
# A2.3 Robustness
################################################################################

# Include 2020-2021 with young x COVID-year dummy
a2_model_covid <- fepois(
  crashes ~ young:post + young:covid | state_abb^t + state_abb^young^quarter,
  offset = ~ log(pop),
  cluster = ~ state_abb,
  data = a2_long
)
print(summary(a2_model_covid))
print(exp(confint(a2_model_covid)["young:post", ]))

# Age-group specific linear trends (pre-existing divergence)
a2_model_trend <- fepois(
  crashes ~ young:post + young:t | state_abb^t + state_abb^young^quarter,
  offset = ~ log(pop),
  cluster = ~ state_abb,
  data = a2_main
)
print(summary(a2_model_trend))
print(exp(confint(a2_model_trend)["young:post", ]))

# Exclude 2022 (telehealth company collapse)
a2_model_no2022 <- fepois(
  crashes ~ young:post | state_abb^t + state_abb^young^quarter,
  offset = ~ log(pop),
  cluster = ~ state_abb,
  data = a2_main %>% filter(year != 2022)
)
print(summary(a2_model_no2022))
print(exp(confint(a2_model_no2022)["young:post", ]))
```

# A3. MAIN DESIGN: DOSE-RESPONSE BY STATE

## A3.1 Data preparation

```{r a3-1}
  mutate(intensity_10 = intensity * 10,

         intensity_amph_only_10 = intensity_amph_only * 10,
         intensity_acute_10 = intensity_acute * 10)

print(nrow(a3_panel))

```

## A3.2 Analysis
```{r a3-2}
################################################################################
# A3.2 Analysis (intensity scaled per 10 percentage points of shortfall)
################################################################################

# Primary: Poisson, population offset, state x quarter-of-year FE, quarter FE, log VMT control
a3_model_primary <- fepois(
  crash_young ~ intensity_10:post + log(vmt_millions) | state_abb^quarter + t,
  offset = ~ log(pop_18_44),
  cluster = ~ state_abb,
  data = a3_panel
)
print(summary(a3_model_primary))
print(coeftable(a3_model_primary)["intensity_10:post", ])
print(exp(confint(a3_model_primary)["intensity_10:post", ]))
print(exp(coef(a3_model_primary)["intensity_10:post"]))

# Event study: intensity x quarter, reference = 2021Q4-2022Q3 (one per season, absorbed by state x season FE)
a3_model_es <- fepois(
  crash_young ~ i(t, intensity_10, ref = c(20, 21, 22, 23)) + log(vmt_millions) | state_abb^quarter + t,
  offset = ~ log(pop_18_44),
  cluster = ~ state_abb,
  data = a3_panel
)
print(summary(a3_model_es))
print(wald(a3_model_es, keep = "t::([1-9]|1[0-2]):intensity_10$"))
print(wald(a3_model_es, keep = "t::(1[3-9]):intensity_10$"))

# Deaths
a3_model_deaths <- fepois(
  deaths_young ~ intensity_10:post + log(vmt_millions) | state_abb^quarter + t,
  offset = ~ log(pop_18_44),
  cluster = ~ state_abb,
  data = a3_panel
)
print(summary(a3_model_deaths))
print(exp(confint(a3_model_deaths)["intensity_10:post", ]))

# Per vehicle miles traveled (VMT offset)
a3_model_vmt <- fepois(
  crash_young ~ intensity_10:post | state_abb^quarter + t,
  offset = ~ log(vmt_millions),
  cluster = ~ state_abb,
  data = a3_panel
)
print(summary(a3_model_vmt))
print(exp(confint(a3_model_vmt)["intensity_10:post", ]))
```

```{r a3-3}
)
```

# A5. REVERSAL AFTER SUPPLY RECOVERY

## A5.1 Data preparation
```{r a5-1}
################################################################################
# A5.1 Data preparation
################################################################################

# Acute shortage 2022Q4-2023Q4; 2024Q1-Q4 = supply back near trend (ARCOS); 2024Q4 = after DEA lisdexamfetamine quota increase (effective 2024-09-05)
a5_panel <- read_excel("clean_data.xlsx", sheet = "panel_state_quarter") %>%
  mutate(intensity_10 = intensity_acute * 10,
         acute = as.integer(t >= 24 & t <= 28),
         recovery = as.integer(t >= 29))

a5_long <- bind_rows(
  a5_panel %>% transmute(state_abb, quarter, t, acute, recovery, post_quota, intensity_10, young = 1, crashes = crash_young, pop = pop_18_44),
  a5_panel %>% transmute(state_abb, quarter, t, acute, recovery, post_quota, intensity_10, young = 0, crashes = crash_older, pop = pop_55_74)
) %>%
  mutate(intensity_young_10 = intensity_10 * young)

print(a5_panel %>% count(acute, recovery))
```

## A5.2 Analysis
```{r a5-2}
################################################################################
# A5.2 Analysis
################################################################################

# Dose-response by phase
a5_model_phase <- fepois(
  crash_young ~ intensity_10:acute + intensity_10:recovery + log(vmt_millions) | state_abb^quarter + t,
  offset = ~ log(pop_18_44),
  cluster = ~ state_abb,
  data = a5_panel
)
print(summary(a5_model_phase))
print(exp(confint(a5_model_phase)))

# Test: recovery effect smaller than acute effect
print(wald(a5_model_phase, keep = "intensity_10:(acute|recovery)"))
print(coef(a5_model_phase)["intensity_10:recovery"] - coef(a5_model_phase)["intensity_10:acute"])

# Triple difference by phase
a5_model_ddd_phase <- fepois(
  crashes ~ intensity_young_10:acute + intensity_young_10:recovery | state_abb^t + state_abb^young^quarter + t^young,
  offset = ~ log(pop),
  cluster = ~ state_abb,
  data = a5_long
)
print(summary(a5_model_ddd_phase))
print(exp(confint(a5_model_ddd_phase)))

# After the DEA quota increase (2024Q4 only)
a5_model_quota <- fepois(
  crash_young ~ intensity_10:acute + intensity_10:recovery + intensity_10:post_quota + log(vmt_millions) | state_abb^quarter + t,
  offset = ~ log(pop_18_44),
  cluster = ~ state_abb,
  data = a5_panel
)
print(summary(a5_model_quota))
print(exp(confint(a5_model_quota)))
```

# X. EXCESS CRASHES AND DEATHS ATTRIBUTABLE TO THE SHORTAGE

## X.1 Data preparation
```{r x1}
################################################################################
# X.1 Data preparation
################################################################################

x_panel <- read_excel("clean_data.xlsx", sheet = "panel_state_quarter") %>%
  mutate(intensity_10 = intensity * 10)

x_post <- x_panel %>% filter(post == 1)
print(c(crash_young_post = sum(x_post$crash_young), deaths_young_post = sum(x_post$deaths_young), quarters = n_distinct(x_post$t)))
```

## X.2 Analysis
```{r x2}
################################################################################
# X.2 Analysis
################################################################################

# Refit primary dose-response and triple difference (copied from A3 and A4)
x_model_dose <- fepois(
  crash_young ~ intensity_10:post + log(vmt_millions) | state_abb^quarter + t,
  offset = ~ log(pop_18_44), cluster = ~ state_abb, data = x_panel
)
x_long <- bind_rows(
  x_panel %>% transmute(state_abb, quarter, t, post, intensity_10, young = 1, crashes = crash_young, pop = pop_18_44),
  x_panel %>% transmute(state_abb, quarter, t, post, intensity_10, young = 0, crashes = crash_older, pop = pop_55_74)
) %>% mutate(intensity_young_10 = intensity_10 * young)
x_model_ddd <- fepois(
  crashes ~ intensity_young_10:post | state_abb^t + state_abb^young^quarter + t^young,
  offset = ~ log(pop), cluster = ~ state_abb, data = x_long
)

# Excess = sum over post state-quarters of observed x (1 - exp(-beta x intensity)); point estimate and 95% CI
x_beta <- tibble(
  model = c("dose-response", "triple difference"),
  est = c(coef(x_model_dose)["intensity_10:post"], coef(x_model_ddd)["intensity_young_10:post"]),
  lo = c(confint(x_model_dose)["intensity_10:post", 1], confint(x_model_ddd)["intensity_young_10:post", 1]),
  hi = c(confint(x_model_dose)["intensity_10:post", 2], confint(x_model_ddd)["intensity_young_10:post", 2])
)

x_excess <- x_beta %>%
  mutate(
    excess_crashes = c(sum(x_post$crash_young * (1 - exp(-est[1] * x_post$intensity_10))), sum(x_post$crash_young * (1 - exp(-est[2] * x_post$intensity_10)))),
    excess_crashes_lo = c(sum(x_post$crash_young * (1 - exp(-lo[1] * x_post$intensity_10))), sum(x_post$crash_young * (1 - exp(-lo[2] * x_post$intensity_10)))),
    excess_crashes_hi = c(sum(x_post$crash_young * (1 - exp(-hi[1] * x_post$intensity_10))), sum(x_post$crash_young * (1 - exp(-hi[2] * x_post$intensity_10)))),
    excess_deaths = c(sum(x_post$deaths_young * (1 - exp(-est[1] * x_post$intensity_10))), sum(x_post$deaths_young * (1 - exp(-est[2] * x_post$intensity_10)))),
    excess_deaths_lo = c(sum(x_post$deaths_young * (1 - exp(-lo[1] * x_post$intensity_10))), sum(x_post$deaths_young * (1 - exp(-lo[2] * x_post$intensity_10)))),
    excess_deaths_hi = c(sum(x_post$deaths_young * (1 - exp(-hi[1] * x_post$intensity_10))), sum(x_post$deaths_young * (1 - exp(-hi[2] * x_post$intensity_10))))
  )
print(x_excess, width = 200)

# Expected excess from expected_effect.md (0.07%-0.44% of post-period young-driver crashes and deaths)
print(c(expected_crashes_low = 0.0007 * sum(x_post$crash_young), expected_crashes_high = 0.0044 * sum(x_post$crash_young),
        expected_deaths_low = 0.0007 * sum(x_post$deaths_young), expected_deaths_high = 0.0044 * sum(x_post$deaths_young)))
```
